import json

wazuh = json.loads('''$query_wazuh_alerts.message''')
if isinstance(wazuh, str):
    try:
        wazuh = json.loads(wazuh)
    except:
        wazuh = {}

tier1 = json.loads('''$query_tier1_matches.message''')
if isinstance(tier1, str):
    try:
        tier1 = json.loads(tier1)
    except:
        tier1 = {}

wazuh_ips = set(wazuh.get("wazuh_ips", []))
tier1_ips = set(tier1.get("tier1_ips", []))
wazuh_details = wazuh.get("wazuh_details", {})
tier1_details = tier1.get("tier1_details", {})

dual_hit_ips = wazuh_ips & tier1_ips

dual_hits = []
for ip in dual_hit_ips:
    wd = wazuh_details.get(ip, {})
    td = tier1_details.get(ip, {})
    dual_hits.append({
        "ip": ip,
        "wazuh_count": wd.get("count", 0),
        "wazuh_max_level": wd.get("max_level", 0),
        "wazuh_top_rule": wd.get("top_rule", ""),
        "wazuh_agents": wd.get("agents", []),
        "tier1_count": td.get("count", 0),
        "tier1_providers": td.get("ti_providers", []),
        "tier1_types": td.get("ti_types", [])
    })

# Sort by Wazuh max_level descending (highest severity first)
dual_hits.sort(key=lambda x: x["wazuh_max_level"], reverse=True)

w_errors = wazuh.get("errors", [])
t_errors = tier1.get("errors", [])

print(json.dumps({
    "dual_hits": dual_hits,
    "dual_hit_count": len(dual_hits),
    "wazuh_total": wazuh.get("wazuh_total", 0),
    "tier1_total": tier1.get("tier1_total", 0),
    "min_level_used": wazuh.get("min_level_used", 7),
    "all_errors": w_errors + t_errors
}))

import json, datetime

data = json.loads('''$correlate.message''')
if isinstance(data, str):
    try:
        data = json.loads(data)
    except:
        data = {}

dual_hits = data.get("dual_hits", [])
dual_hit_count = data.get("dual_hit_count", 0)
wazuh_total = data.get("wazuh_total", 0)
tier1_total = data.get("tier1_total", 0)
min_level = data.get("min_level_used", 7)
all_errors = data.get("all_errors", [])

KIBANA_URL = "http://10.10.30.25:5601/app/discover#/?_g=(time:(from:now-24h,to:now))"

def sanitize(s):
    return str(s).replace('"', "'").replace("\\", "")[:200]

now = datetime.datetime.utcnow().strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")

if dual_hit_count > 0:
    fields = []
    for hit in dual_hits[:10]:
        ip = hit["ip"]
        agents_str = ", ".join(hit.get("wazuh_agents", [])[:3])
        providers_str = ", ".join(hit.get("tier1_providers", [])[:3])
        types_str = ", ".join(hit.get("tier1_types", [])[:3])
        rule_text = sanitize(hit.get("wazuh_top_rule", ""))
        val = (f"Wazuh: {hit.get('wazuh_count', 0)} alerts, "
               f"max level {hit.get('wazuh_max_level', 0)}, "
               f"'{rule_text}' on {agents_str}\n"
               f"TI: {hit.get('tier1_count', 0)} matches, "
               f"{providers_str}, {types_str}")
        fields.append({"name": f"`{ip}`", "value": val[:1024], "inline": False})

    footer_text = (f"WF-HACCP-3 nightly | "
                   f"Wazuh: {wazuh_total} (lvl>={min_level}) | "
                   f"tier1: {tier1_total} | "
                   f"drill: {KIBANA_URL[:60]}...")
    if dual_hit_count > 10:
        footer_text += f" | +{dual_hit_count - 10} more (raise min_alert_level or check Kibana)"
    if all_errors:
        footer_text += f" | {len(all_errors)} query error(s)"

    embed = {
        "title": f"WF-HACCP-3: {dual_hit_count} dual-hit IP(s) in last 24h",
        "description": f"IPs that triggered both a Wazuh alert (level >= {min_level}) and a haccp tier1 TI match.",
        "color": 15158332,
        "fields": fields,
        "footer": {"text": footer_text[:2048]},
        "timestamp": now
    }
    body = json.dumps({"embeds": [embed]})

    # Truncate if embed exceeds Discord limit
    if len(body) > 5500:
        while len(embed["fields"]) > 1 and len(json.dumps({"embeds": [embed]})) > 5500:
            embed["fields"].pop()
        embed["fields"].append({"name": "...", "value": f"+{dual_hit_count - len(embed['fields']) + 1} more, see Kibana", "inline": False})
        body = json.dumps({"embeds": [embed]})
else:
    content = (f"WF-HACCP-3 nightly cross-correlation: "
              f"0 dual-hits in last 24h. "
              f"Wazuh alerts with IPs: {wazuh_total} (level >= {min_level}), "
              f"tier1 TI matches: {tier1_total}.")
    if all_errors:
        content += f" ({len(all_errors)} query error(s))"
    body = json.dumps({"content": content})

print(json.dumps({"body": body}))

name: WF-HACCP-3: Nightly Wazuh Cross-Correlator
description: Nightly workflow that queries brisket Wazuh alerts and haccp tier1 TI matches from the same 24h window, joins on IP intersection, and posts dual-hit indicators to #soc-alerts. Zero Ollama calls, zero TheHive cases.
